metrics.notes: AA per-model-page result; separate from vendor-reported HLE and other harnesses.

metrics.name: OSWorld 2.1 (partial score)
metrics.notes: Anthropic Sonnet 5.5 launch/system-card OSWorld 2.1 is distinct from OSWorld 2.0 and OSWorld-Verified. From the Haiku 5.5 launch (2026-10-07) Anthropic reports the official offline subset (82 of 108 tasks, no VM internet); those rows carry an "offline-subset" comparability_group and are not comparable with the earlier full-set Sonnet 5.5 readings (Sonnet 5.5: 80.1% full-set launch vs 83.9% offline subset).

metrics.name: OSWorld 2.1 (strict pass rate)
metrics.notes: Fraction of tasks with every checkpoint satisfied (Pass@1, five attempts per task), as defined in Anthropic system cards. Companion to osworld-2-1 (partial score). First rows: Haiku 5.5 System Card, official offline subset (82 tasks).

metrics.name: PhysicianBench
metrics.notes: Public benchmark of 100 physician tasks in an electronic health record; share of attempts passed (five per task). First rows: Haiku 5.5 System Card, including per-effort values.

metrics.name: Vals Index
metrics.notes: Vals AI composite across finance, coding, legal, tax and related agent tasks, weighted by sector (overall task on the Vals Index board). Third-party board; rows carry the board's own reasoning/compute effort field and a per-board comparability_group.

metrics.name: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.3 (as reported by Meta)
metrics.notes: Artificial Analysis index values (integers) as republished by Meta in its Muse Wonder launch table and blog chart, 0-100 scale. Kept apart from artificial-analysis-intelligence-index-v4-3-2 (third_party_board rows with decimals) because the source class differs; Meta calls the index v4.3 and Artificial Analysis's page names v4.3.2 with the same ten evaluations.

metrics.name: Personal Superintelligence Index
metrics.notes: Meta internal composite of seven personal and knowledge-work evaluations: Agents' Last Exam, AutomationBench-AA, FocusBench, JobBench, GDP.pdf, VBT and DRACO. Not reproducible outside Meta. First rows: Meta Muse Wonder launch (2026-10-12).

metrics.name: Harvey LAB-AA v1.1
metrics.notes: Artificial Analysis's version of Harvey's Legal Agent Benchmark, v1.1 (adds hallucination checks): share of tasks whose deliverable meets every criterion and passes the hallucination checks. Distinct from harvey-legal-agent-benchmark (vendor tables). First rows: Meta Muse Wonder launch table.

metrics.name: JobBench
metrics.notes: 65 professional tasks across 35 white-collar occupations; mean reward against task-specific rubrics (Meta description). First rows: Meta Muse Wonder launch table.

metrics.name: MemoryBench
metrics.notes: Meta internal: recall of critical facts across 64K-100K-token multi-turn conversations with distractors and conflicting or updating turns; LLM judge with weighted question-specific rubrics. Not public. First rows: Meta Muse Wonder launch table.

metrics.name: SWE-Marathon
metrics.notes: Ultra-long-horizon software-engineering benchmark of substantial projects graded by executing project tests; pass@1. Abundant AI is the result source; leaderboard results use each vendor harness (Codex for GPT-6 Astra, Claude Code for Claude Fable 5.1), so cross-model rows are not a controlled comparison. First rows: Meta Muse Wonder launch table.

metrics.name: FocusBench
metrics.notes: Meta internal evaluation of personal agentic tasks (housing, travel, IT, finance) that tests persistence through real-world blockers across multiple interactions. Not public. First rows: Meta Muse Wonder blog chart.

metrics.name: Mishandling personal information (violation rate)
metrics.notes: Meta blog chart "Mishandling Personal Information", violation rate, lower is better. Dataset and grader not described in the blog or model card.

metrics.name: Executing unauthorized code (attack success rate)
metrics.notes: Meta blog chart "Executing Unauthorized Code", attack success rate, lower is better. Dataset and grader not described.

metrics.name: Cyber Misuse Refusal Benchmark
metrics.notes: Meta blog chart, refusal rate, higher is better. Dataset not described.

metrics.name: Cyber Defense Compliance Benchmark
metrics.notes: Meta blog chart, compliance rate on defensive cyber requests, higher is better. Dataset not described.

metrics.name: BioTIER refusal rate
metrics.notes: SecureBio's BioTIER benchmark of safety mitigations for high-risk dual-use biological topics; refusal rate, higher is better. Model card variants: English, Multilingual, Adversarial. The blog chart does not name its variant.

metrics.name: Meta internal chemistry refusal
metrics.notes: Meta in-house refusal benchmark on high-risk chemistry questions; refusal rate, higher is better. Variants: English, Multilingual (10 language buckets), Adversarial.

metrics.name: CyberBench adversarial attack success rate
metrics.notes: Adversarial refusal, ASR %, lower is better; single-turn and multi-turn variants (model card, Muse Wonder Full only).

metrics.name: PolyGuard (cyber subset) attack success rate
metrics.notes: Adversarial refusal, ASR %, lower is better; single-turn and multi-turn variants (model card, Muse Wonder Full only).

metrics.name: RedCode attack success rate
metrics.notes: Adversarial refusal, ASR %, lower is better; single-turn and multi-turn variants (model card, Muse Wonder Full only).

metrics.name: SecureBio Molecular Biology Capabilities Test (MBCT)
metrics.notes: Dual-use bio/chem knowledge proxy evaluation (SecureBio and Center for AI Safety): practical troubleshooting across molecular-biology tasks.

metrics.name: SecureBio Human Pathogens Capabilities Test (HPCT)
metrics.notes: Dual-use proxy evaluation: practical knowledge about working with high-priority human pathogens.

metrics.name: SecureBio Virology Capabilities Test (VCT)
metrics.notes: Dual-use proxy evaluation: wet-lab virology troubleshooting.

metrics.name: SecureBio dual-use average (MBCT, HPCT, VCT)
metrics.notes: Average of MBCT, HPCT and VCT as printed in the Muse Wonder model card.

metrics.name: LAB-Bench v1 ProtocolQA
metrics.notes: Debugging of practical wet-lab protocols (LAB-Bench v1). Not LABBench2 and not the OpenAI open-ended variant (protocolqa-open-ended).

metrics.name: LAB-Bench v1 SeqQA (with tools)
metrics.notes: 15 common DNA-sequence analysis and modification tasks (LAB-Bench v1), tool-assisted.

metrics.name: ABC Bench: Liquid Handling
metrics.notes: SecureBio Agentic Bio-Capabilities Benchmark liquid-handling-robot script task. Fragment Design and Screening Evasion cells are dashes in the Muse Wonder model card: high refusal rate due to safety training, refusals dropped prior to scoring.

metrics.name: Meta BioDesign Tools (BDT)
metrics.notes: Meta with Faculty.AI and external experts: complex computational tasks with dual-use potential across Host-Pathogen Interaction, Protein Design and Sequence Analysis; averaged over five tasks.

metrics.name: MASK (honesty under pressure)
metrics.notes: Whether the model keeps honesty when pressured to contradict its baseline knowledge; higher is better.

metrics.name: Agentic Misalignment (harmful action rate)
metrics.notes: Whether an agent takes harmful actions to advance its objectives or avoid replacement or shutdown; lower is better.

metrics.name: PostTrainBench v1.1
metrics.notes: Google's run of PostTrainBench v1.1: OpenCode harness, 10-hour budget on a single NVIDIA H100, weighted aggregate across four base models and seven benchmarks (Gemini 4 Argon methodology page). Distinct from posttrainbench-lite.

metrics.name: RiemannBench
metrics.notes: Surge public leaderboard reading as quoted in Google's Gemini 4 Argon launch table.

metrics.name: GraphWalks BFS F1 (up to 128k subset)
metrics.notes: Google's subset: the 650 GraphWalks items with context up to 128k tokens, self-computed for all models (Gemini 4 Argon methodology). F1 stored as unit accuracy to match the other GraphWalks ids. Not the same subset as graphwalks-bfs-256k-f1 or graphwalks-bfs-1mil-f1.

metrics.name: GraphWalks BFS F1 (256k to 1M subset)
metrics.notes: Google's subset: 200 GraphWalks problems with context between 256k and 1M tokens, self-computed for all models (Gemini 4 Argon methodology). Not the same slice as graphwalks-bfs-256k-f1 or graphwalks-bfs-1mil-f1.

metrics.name: CWE-bench v1
metrics.notes: End-to-end autonomous security audit and patch synthesis across six programming languages without prior bug localization (Gemini 4 Argon Safety and Security Report). Ranked on Pass@1 with ties broken by Pass@4; each leaderboard row carries its own harness (Antigravity, Codex, Claude Code, opencode). Rows read from Google's launch table and chart, not from the board itself.

metrics.name: Gray Swan Indirect Prompt Injection benchmark attack success rate (k=15)
metrics.notes: Attack success rate across 15 adaptive attempts, as plotted on Google's Gemini 4 Argon post (values sourced from Gray Swan per the methodology page). Lower is better. Distinct from gray-swan-ipi-arena-asr (the 1,810-attack Arena set).

metrics.name: Real-world Vulnerability Discovery (Google internal)
metrics.notes: Google-internal recall of recent, confirmed historical vulnerabilities in popular open source projects across 20 programming languages; Antigravity harness, source access, Pass@1. No public dataset.

metrics.name: Wiz Penetration Test Benchmark
metrics.notes: Wiz-internal black-box benchmark: write exploits against real web application vulnerabilities without codebase access; Pass@1. No public dataset.

metrics.name: ERQA (Embodied Reasoning Question Answering)
metrics.notes: Physical and spatial reasoning benchmark quoted in Google's Gemini 4 Argon launch post (87% without tools, 'pure reasoning'). Published without comparison values.

metrics.name: Arena WebDev Elo
metrics.notes: Arena (formerly LMArena) WebDev board preference Elo. Not the Text Coding category.

metrics.name: MedCode (Vals AI)
metrics.notes: Medical billing support tasks (Vals AI, one-shot).

metrics.name: MedScribe (Vals AI)
metrics.notes: Administrative work for doctors (Vals AI, one-shot).

metrics.name: SAGE (Vals AI)
metrics.notes: Student Assessment with Generative Evaluation (Vals AI, one-shot).

metrics.name: SRE Bench (Vals AI)
metrics.notes: Reverse engineering of real-world binaries by agents (Vals AI).

metrics.name: LegalBench (Vals AI)
metrics.notes: Open source legal reasoning tasks (Vals AI, one-shot).

metrics.name: CUA-bench (Vals AI)
metrics.notes: Computer-use agents playing six commercial video games; half held out (Vals AI). Each model runs in its own agent harness.

metrics.name: Time Horizon Index: KSP (Vals AI)
metrics.notes: An agent builds and runs a space program in Kerbal Space Program (Vals AI).

metrics.name: AutomationBench-AA: Agentic SaaS Workflow Benchmark
metrics.notes: Artificial Analysis's agentic SaaS workflow benchmark. In the v5 Index at 5% of the overall Index, within Knowledge Work. Not the same measurement as the vendor-table id 'automationbench'.

metrics.name: FrontierCode 2.0 Benchmark
metrics.notes: Cognition's private benchmark of real-world coding tasks, graded on whether a repository maintainer would merge the change. In the v5 Index at 15% of the overall Index, within Coding. Distinct from frontiercode-1-1-main and frontiercode-1-1-extended.

metrics.name: HLE-Diamond Benchmark
metrics.notes: AA's refined 1,000-question version of Humanity's Last Exam, split evenly between reasoning and knowledge questions. The v5 article says it replaces Humanity's Last Exam. In the v5 Index at 10% of the overall Index, within General.

metrics.name: CritPt v2 hard subset
metrics.notes: A private, 40-question hard subset of CritPt v2, revised by the CritPt authors and run with a code-execution tool. In the v5 Index at 10% of the overall Index, within Science. Not the same measurement as aa-critpt or epoch-critpt.

metrics.name: AA-Omniscience v1.1: Knowledge and Hallucination Benchmark
metrics.notes: AA's knowledge and hallucination benchmark, v1.1: saturated and public-set questions removed, new questions added. In the v5 Index at 15% of the overall Index, within General (10% accuracy, 5% non-hallucination). Distinct from the unversioned aa-omniscience id.
